events.verdict: Doncic (LAL) extends his hand into Booker's (PHX) body and delivers contact that affects his SQBR.
Smart (LAL) and Gillespie (PHX) briefly engage and disengage during the inbound.
Gillespie (PHX) grazes James' (LAL) arm as he secures the pass.
Allen (PHX) deflects the ball away from Ayton (LAL).
Brooks (PHX) overtly, and abruptly, veers in Smart (LAL), delivering contact that dislodges him from his position.
Doncic (LAL) avoids making contact with Brooks' (PHX) arm as he contests the jump shot attempt.
Doncic (LAL) does not overtly, or abruptly, raise his arm up into Brooks' (PHX) head as they come together in the backcourt.
Brooks (PHX) and Doncic (LAL) briefly engage and disengage off-ball.
Brooks (PHX) and Doncic (LAL) come together at the same spot, and the contact as Doncic secures the pass is marginal.
Doncic (LAL) overtly, and abruptly, extends his leg into Brooks (PHX) and initiates more than marginal contact that affects his ability to defend.
Brooks (PHX) absorbs the contact from Doncic (LAL) as he retreats within his path.
Brooks (PHX) moves alongside James' (LAL) path as he defends the shot attempt.
Smart (LAL) is moving alongside Booker's (PHX) path as he defends the drive.
Williams (PHX) establishes himself in James' (LAL) path prior to the contact.

Smart (LAL) extends his right arm away from his body and initiates contact with Allen (PHX) during the shot.  While Smart does make contact with the ball, the body contact occurs prior to any contact with the ball, and Smart initiates further contact with Allen's shoulder after he removes his hand from the ball.
Dunn (PHX) cleanly blocks Smart's (LAL) shot attempt.
James (LAL) contests to the side of Brooks (PHX) and would avoid making contact if not for Brooks extending his left leg/knee towards James.
Brooks (PHX) is assessed a technical foul for unsportsmanlike physical contact with James (LAL) during a dead ball situation.
Doncic (LAL) establishes himself in O'Neale's (PHX) path prior to the contact.
Smart (LAL) and Gillespie (PHX) briefly engage and disengage off-ball.

Replay review of the foul called on Booker (PHX) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed unsuccessful.  Booker initiates contact with James' (LAL) right arm/wrist as he is starting his upward shooting motion.
Allen (PHX) gathers the ball on his left foot and takes two legal steps after his gather.
LaRavia (LAL) is moving alongside Allen's (PHX) path as they come together on the perimeter.
James (LAL) makes contact with the ball as he defends Allen's (PHX) shot attempt.

Gillespie (PHX) initiates contact with Smart's (LAL) arm and the contact affects his control of the ball.  After communicating with the Replay Center, it was determined the foul ocurred with 0.4 seconds remaining on the game clock.
